news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹11.11 (up from ₹8.21 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹630.3b (down 11% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹16.1b (up 36% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.6% (up from 1.7% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.9%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 15%. Revenue is forecast to grow 2.5% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Insurance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 22% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

What's in the News ICICI Prudential Life Insurance has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.65 per equity share for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting, source: company board meeting on April 14, 2026.

news.title: Upcoming dividend of ₹1.65 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 05 June 2026. Payment date: 30 July 2026. Payout ratio is a comfortable 15% but the company is not cash flow positive. Trailing yield: 0.3%. Lower than top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.5%). Lower than average of industry peers (0.9%).

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹1.65
news.body: Dividend of ₹1.65 is 94% higher than last year. Ex-date: 5th June 2026 Payment date: 30th July 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.3%, which is lower than the industry average of 0.4%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (15% earnings payout ratio) but the company has no free cash flows available, indicating it may be using cash reserves or debt to pay the dividend. The dividend has decreased over the past 10 years, indicating a lack of growth and stability in payments. EPS is expected to grow by 31% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: New minor risk - Dividend sustainability
news.body: The dividend is not well covered by cash flows. The company is paying a dividend despite having no free cash flows. Dividend yield: 0.3% This is considered a minor risk. Dividends are ultimately paid out of the company's available cash reserves. Companies that pay out too much of their cash flow are at risk of having to reduce or cut their dividend in future. If cash flow growth slows or cash flows fall, then there may not be enough cash reserves to maintain the same dividend. Or in extreme cases, companies may opt to take on debt to maintain the dividend. This risk is mitigated by the fact the dividend is covered by earnings, however, cash flows are generally more important. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.68 (vs ₹2.25 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.68 (up from ₹2.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹229.0b (up 397% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.87b (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.7% (down from 7.0% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is expected to decline by 3.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Insurance industry in India are expected to grow by 9.8%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 19% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 15% per year.

news.title: ICICIPRULI: Upcoming Board Meetings Will Support Steady Margin Outlook

What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on Feb 05, 2026, at 09:35 Indian Standard Time to consider a change in the company’s Internal Auditor, indicating a potential shift in the internal audit function (Key Developments).
